# Shubham Kulkarni — AI Engineer Portfolio

> Shubham Kulkarni is a production AI Engineer with 1+ years of experience at Arya Omnitalk Wireless Solutions (Arvind Group), Pune, where he is a core engineer on VIDES (edge traffic enforcement on NVIDIA Jetson) and TMCS (NHAI ATMS-aligned highway incident detection). He specializes in Computer Vision (YOLOv8, ByteTrack, TensorRT, OSNet), Generative AI (LangGraph, DSPy, Compound AI, Hybrid RAG with FAISS+BM25+RRF), Edge AI deployment (NVIDIA Jetson, ONNX, Rockchip), and MLOps (FastAPI, Docker, Triton, Prometheus). He led his team to AIR 1 (National Champion) at Smart India Hackathon 2023.

## Production Impact & Key Metrics

- **50,000+ Events / Day:** VIDES edge traffic-enforcement network on live national highways — 14 detection types (ANPR, helmet, triple riding, seatbelt, speed, wrong-way, stopped vehicle, accident, pedestrian, animal, pothole) from 7 models on one NVIDIA Jetson.
- **<40 ms Frame Processing / <150 ms Alerts:** GPU-direct GStreamer ingest across 6 concurrent 1080p RTSP streams; SSE → Socket.IO operator alerting.
- **TMCS Incident Detection:** 7 incident rules, 11 object classes, 1.5 ms p50 tracking + rules latency, SHA-256 write-once evidence, 298+ automated tests.
- **12ms Inference Latency:** YOLOv8 + ByteTrack optimized with NVIDIA TensorRT on edge hardware.
- **150,000+ Queries / Day:** ATMS vehicle forensic re-identification powered by OSNet deep appearance embeddings and FAISS IVF-PQ vector indexing (30× faster than baseline).
- **95% Model Accuracy:** Real-time multi-camera detection across 7 vehicle classes with zero-duplicate Kalman filtering.
- **99.9% Uptime:** Mission-critical highway and enterprise AI services.
- **AIR 1 National Champion:** Smart India Hackathon 2023 (Team Lead for AI E-Waste Management System).

- **Edge AI & Hardware:** NVIDIA Jetson, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, TensorRT-LLM, Rockchip RK3588, Raspberry Pi, Arduino Mega, PID Control.

## Featured Production Systems & Projects

- [VIDES — Edge Traffic Enforcement Network](https://shubhamkulkarni.me/#vides): ATCC and enforcement on NVIDIA Jetson Orin at every gantry — detection, ByteTrack tracking, ANPR with 2-read OCR consensus, helmet/seatbelt/speed/wrong-way/accident/pedestrian/animal/pothole detection, 50K+ events/day at 95% accuracy. [Article](https://shubhamkulkarni.me/blog/vehicle-detection-system.html)
- [TMCS — Highway Incident Detection](https://shubhamkulkarni.me/#tmcs): Turns PTZ highway cameras into automated incident detectors aligned with NHAI ATMS Standards (2023) — dual-model YOLOv8 + RT-DETR, occlusion-resilient tracking, 7 incident rules, court-grade evidence. [Solution overview (PDF)](https://shubhamkulkarni.me/Asset/TMCS_Client_Solution_Overview.pdf)
- [ATMS Vehicle Forensic Re-Identification](https://shubhamkulkarni.me/blog/vehicle-re-identification.html): In-memory forensic vehicle matching system serving 150K+ daily queries at <100ms latency using OSNet + FAISS IVF-PQ without database overhead.
- [Open Source Data Annotation Tool for CV](https://github.com/kulkarnishub377/Data_Annotation_Tool): Local-first, privacy-focused alternative to CVAT & Roboflow. End-to-end dataset platform featuring model-assisted auto-annotation (100,000 images in 30 mins on NVIDIA Orin NX 16GB), bbox & polygon segmentation, 5-point dataset health QA dashboard, multi-format inference (.pt, .onnx, .engine), auto splitting, and in-browser model fine-tuning with live SSE logs. [GitHub](https://github.com/kulkarnishub377/Data_Annotation_Tool) | [Case Study](https://shubhamkulkarni.me/blog/data-annotation-tool.html)
- [OmniSight](https://shubhamkulkarni.me/OmniSight/): Autonomous multi-modal AI incident intelligence fabric ingesting IoT, vision, and audio signals with an Agentic workflow engine. [Case Study](https://shubhamkulkarni.me/blog/omnisight.html) | [GitHub](https://github.com/kulkarnishub377/OmniSight)
- [DocuAI Studio v3.1](https://shubhamkulkarni.me/blog/docuai-studio-v3-1.html): Production Document AI & Hybrid RAG platform (FAISS + BM25 + RRF) with streaming Q&A, knowledge graphs, and 40+ REST API endpoints. [GitHub](https://github.com/kulkarnishub377/Document-AI---RAG-Pipeline)
- [CivicMind](https://shubhamkulkarni.me/CivicMind/): Multi-agent smart city decision intelligence platform using Gemini 2.5 orchestration, digital twin simulation, and Explainable AI (XAI). [Case Study](https://shubhamkulkarni.me/blog/civicmind.html) | [GitHub](https://github.com/kulkarnishub377/CivicMind)
- [KeyFlow AI Typing Studio](https://shubhamkulkarni.me/keyflow-ai-typing/): Local-first adaptive typing trainer with 10 deterministic AI agents, sub-millisecond telemetry, Web Audio DSP synthesis, and 18 MB standalone binary. [Case Study](https://shubhamkulkarni.me/blog/keyflow-ai-typing.html) | [GitHub](https://github.com/kulkarnishub377/keyflow-ai-typing)
- [Smart Irrigation System](https://shubhamkulkarni.me/JalTantra/): IoT + ML precision agriculture water optimization saving 30% water. University Rank 2, SPPU Startup Olympiad 2025. [Overview](https://shubhamkulkarni.me/blog/smart-irrigation.html) | [Win Story](https://shubhamkulkarni.me/blog/sih-win-2023.html)

[Case Study](https://shubhamkulkarni.me/blog/alumni-portal.html) | [GitHub](https://github.com/kulkarnishub377/Alumni_Management_portal)
- [Mental Health AI Tracker](https://shubhamkulkarni.me/blog/mental-health-ai.html): NLP sentiment & burnout detection system built during IBM India internship with 90% accuracy.
